title: The Trinity and the Bible
welcome_lead: Unpack the Christian belief in one God in three persons and the book that guides millions.

concepts.def: One God in three persons: Father, Son, Holy Spirit.

Second part of the Bible, about Jesus and the Church.

walkthroughs.body_html: Christians believe in one God in three persons: the Father (creator), the Son (Jesus Christ) and the Holy Spirit (God at work in the world). This is called the Trinity. It is mysterious but central to Christian faith.

The Christian Bible has two main parts. The Old Testament (39 books in most Protestant Bibles) is shared with Judaism and includes the Torah, Psalms and Prophets. The New Testament (27 books) is about Jesus and the early Church.
The New Testament begins with four Gospels: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. Each tells the story of Jesus's life, teaching, death and resurrection from a slightly different viewpoint.

Virtue ethics is about following the Ten Commandments.
